announcements.headline: Hexatronic Group AB (publ) Interim report Q3 2026

announcements.headline: Bulletin from Extraordinary General Meeting in Hexatronic Group AB (publ)
announcements.insight: The meeting confirms the share increase announced in June and facilitates the LTIP maturity declared in July.

announcements.insight: LTIP shares are transferred following the Q2 interim report. This reflects routine executive compensation mechanics rather than strategic shifts.
